name: Wrapping — Put a Sock on It
summary: Slip a sock over the vibrator to soften its intensity and alter the vibration—an easy, adorable cover-up that changes the feel.
detailed_description: A simple sock is a ready-made wrapping cover. Pulled over the vibrator, it dampens raw intensity and reshapes the buzz into something softer. Sock thickness and texture change the result, and it doubles as a discreet cover-up.
stepwise_structure: 1. Slip a clean sock over the head of the vibrator.
2. Use it over the target area to feel the softened, altered vibration.
3. Try different sock thicknesses/textures to tune the intensity.
safety_notes: Use a clean sock; wash between uses for hygiene.
Thicker socks reduce intensity if the buzz is too strong.
